doc: Act II's Vowbound call stings (M4-A2P-091): battle_sfx.json `vowbound_stings` plays them on the Music bus when the Vowbound is called, as Act I's virel_summon. Files from assets_src/music/act2/vowbound_stings.py (plain git, ADR 0175). Kesh has no call sting in Act II (kesh_summon is Act III's H03).

nhoa_summon._note: M4-A2P-091 music sting (assets_src/music/act2/vowbound_stings.py): Nhoa called: glass rising through the Letting's cell, the only Vowbound whose motes go up

hesk_summon._note: M4-A2P-091 music sting (assets_src/music/act2/vowbound_stings.py): Hesk called: the cords plucked in a rising sweep, and the bell
